# Invite

An invitation sent by e-mail, either to join a tenant or to register a new one.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `invitationCodeId` | `uuid` | The id of the invitation code the invite was sent with. |
| `emailAddress` | `string` | The e-mail address the invite was sent to. Only that address can accept it. |
| `inviteToTenant` | `boolean` | Whether the invite joins the inviter's tenant (true) or registers a new tenant (false). |
| `status` | [`InviteStatus`](invite-status.md) | Whether the invite is still open, was cancelled or has been accepted. |
| `grantsAdmin` | `boolean \| null` | True when the person who accepts the invite (`POST /users/register`) joins as a tenant admin (`Tenant.Admin`) rather than an ordinary member. Null or false: an ordinary member. |
| `userCreatedById` | `uuid` | The id of the user who created it. A call made with an API key is recorded as the key's user. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |
